subject: How to change the text in the panel strips?

messages.author: 20a857807016d58a
messages.subject: How to change the text in the panel strips?
parts:
Dear expeRts,

How can I get "psi=0.2", "psi=0.5", and "psi=0.8" [with greek psi] in
the upper
"panel strips" and "alpha", "beta",... in the "panel strips" on the
right [showing
"group.1", "group.2", etc. so far]?

Cheers,

Marius


require(ggplot2)
require(reshape2)

## parameters of some model
p1 <- c(20, 50, 100, 200)
p2 <- c(5, 10, 20, 50, 100)
p3 <- c("group.1","group.2","group.3","group.4","group.5")
p4 <- c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8)

## replications
N <- 1000

## lengths
l1 <- length(p1)
l2 <- length(p2)
l3 <- length(p3)
l4 <- length(p4)

## build result array containing the measurements
arr <- array(rep(NA, l1*l2*l3*l4*N), dim=c(l1, l2, l3, l4, N),
dimnames=list(
p1=p1,
p2=p2,
p3=p3,
p4=p4,
N=1:N))

## fill the result array (dummy here) with values
for(i in 1:l1){
for(j in 1:l2){
for(k in 1:l3){
for(l in 1:l4){
arr[i,j,k,l,] <- i+j+k+l+runif(N)
}
}
}
}

## create molten data
mdf <- melt(arr, formula = . ~ + p1 + p2 + p3 + p4 + N) # create
molten data frame
colnames(mdf) # => fine
stopifnot(dim(mdf)==c(l1*l2*l3*l4*N, 6))

## build means (dummy function here)
mdf.mean <- dcast(mdf, p1 + p2 + p3 + p4 ~ "Value",
fun.aggregate=mean, value_var="value")
str(mdf.mean)

## plot
ggplot(mdf.mean, aes(x=p2, y=Value, colour=p1)) + geom_point() +
geom_line(aes(group=p1)) + facet_grid(p3 ~ p4)

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: How to change the text in the panel strips?
parts:
Hi:

You could have found this by searching the list archives, but it was a
good excuse for me to relearn how to do this. The following changes
work for me:

# Create a factor variable for p4 with the plotmath text of the labels as
# the labels argument:
mdf.mean$psi4 <- factor(mdf.mean$p4, levels = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8),
labels = c('psi == 0.2', 'psi == 0.5', 'psi == 0.8'))
# Use the labeller in facet_grid():

geom_line(aes(group=p1)) + facet_grid(p3 ~ psi4, labeller = label_parsed)

For the reference, see Hadley's first response to this thread from 2009:
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/7583b95989b68815/2f5285f34f8b7494?lnk=gst&q=expression+strip+panel#2f5285f34f8b7494

HTH,
Dennis
